First and Second Conditionals (Real possibilities vs Hypothetical situations)
Third Conditional (Past unreal situations, regrets, and missed opportunities)
Present Perfect Simple vs Past Simple (Unfinished time vs Finished time)
Present Perfect Continuous (Duration of continuous actions starting in the past)
Past Continuous vs Past Simple (Interrupted actions in the past using when/while)
Passive Voice (Present, Past, and Future tenses in active to passive transformation)
Modal Verbs of Obligation and Necessity (Must, Have to, Should, Ought to)
Modal Verbs of Deduction and Certainty (Must be, Can't be, Might be)
Defining and Non-defining Relative Clauses (Who, Which, That, Where, Whose)
Reported Speech (Direct to Indirect speech with tense and pronoun shifts)
Habitual Past: Used to vs Would vs Be/Get used to
Gerunds vs Infinitives (Verbs followed by -ing vs Verbs followed by to-infinitive)
Expressing Wishes and Regrets (Wish / If only for present and past)
Quantifiers and Articles (A few, A little, Plenty of, Both, Neither, Either)
Time Clauses and Conjunctions (As soon as, Until, Unless, Provided that)
